The post ADS response hook runs after MediaTailor parses an ADS response and resolves all VAST wrappers, enabling customers to call a secondary ad source when the primary one returns insufficient demand, remove disallowed ads based on content or brand policies, and add house ads or promotions from their marketing systems. The pre manifest insertion hook runs at the last point before MediaTailor returns the ad pod to the viewer, allowing customers to make a final check on what is about to play and insert personalized slates when necessary.
